value.rationale: This is a complete structural and quantitatively sharp boundary of the ordinal-transition Markov-walk modeling practice motivated by the 2026 source: the underlying expanding map has mixing, yet the coarse ordinal observations have provably unbounded order memory, with exponential rare-event distortion by an otherwise fast-mixing calibrated surrogate. The Jordan-block mechanism explains the exact polynomial prefactor and is meaningful beyond a small finite counterexample.
